book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.adv: The Advanced Combat Armor is a Tier 3 armor and intended to be used for combat. It's stats are a direct upgrade of the [Combat Armor](entry://armors/combat_armor). The Advanced Combat Armor can be upgraded to the [Exo Suit](entry://armors/exosuit).
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.arm: * Armor Mechanics *

Techguns armors are equipped like normal minecraft armors but they have a lot of special features.

Techguns armors are not destroyed at 0 durability, they stop to give their stats when reaching 1 durability and no longer take damage.

Techguns armor can be repaired at the 'Repair Bench'. Each ammo has a defined amount of materials that is need dependent on durability. Repairing an armor is cheaper than creating a new one. The amount of repair materials needed is shown in the tooltip at the repair bench.
Armor Repairing

Some armors are **'Powered Armors'** which means they need power to operate. Currently there are two power types in the game: **Steam** and **RF**. Only the chestplate consumes power providing items and powers the other slots. Wearing two different power types does not work. Powered armors only provide their bonus stats when they are powered. Protection is given also without power.
Powered Armors

The chestplate automatically consumes the required power item from the player's inventory when it's empty. The chestplate provides the power to other equipped slots with the same power-type. Some bonus effects drain additional power when used, for example the jump boost will drain extra power each time you jump.
Reloading Armors
* Armor Stats *

When holding \[shift\] a detailed tooltip shows all stats of an armor.

- [Power](entry://armors/armor_stats@power_type)
- [PowerType](entry://armors/armor_stats@power_type)
-
- [Toughness](entry://armors/armor_stats@durability_toughness)
- [Armor-Values](entry://armors/armor_stats@armor)
- [Penetration-Resistance](entry://armors/armor_stats@armor)

The following bonus effects can be provided by armors:

- [Move speed](entry://armors/armor_stats@move_mine_speed)
- [Mining speed](entry://armors/armor_stats@move_mine_speed)
- [Fall damage](entry://armors/armor_stats@fall_damage)
- [Fall height](entry://armors/armor_stats@fall_damage)
- [Gun accuracy](entry://armors/armor_stats@accuracy)
- [Extra Hearts](entry://armors/armor_stats@accuracy)
- [Nightvision](entry://armors/armor_stats@nightvision)
- [Step-Assist](entry://armors/armor_stats@nightvision)
- [Oxygen Gear](entry://armors/armor_stats@oxygen)
- [Cooling System](entry://armors/armor_stats@cooling)
Bonus Effects
Oxygen gear allows the player to breath underwater when oxygen tanks are equipped in the player's back slot (TODO:tg inventory).
Oxygen gear
A cooling system automatically extinguishes the player when burning while draining Power from the armor. Also absorbs lava damage at the cost of power.
Cooling System

Power shows the current and maximum amount of power the armor holds. PowerType shows the [Power-Type](entry://armors/armor_mechanics@powered_armors) and the item used to reload the armor. The reload item is automatically consumed from the players ammo inventory and regular inventory.
Power & PowerType

Item Durability and Armor Toughness are vanilla minecraft mechanics. Techguns armors do not get destroyed by reaching 0 durability, see [Armor Mechanics](entry://armors/armor_mechanics). Otherwise both mechanics work like vanilla.
Durability & Toughness
Armor Values shows the armor value against each different damage type. TODO: Damage Types Entry. Penetration resistance: TODO finalize damage formula.
Armor & Penetration

Movement speed bonus increases a players movement speed by the given percentage. Mining speed increases the speed while harvesting a block.\
Underwater mining speed bonus is only applied when the player is under water.
Move & Mining speed

Fall damage reduces the damage taken from falling by the given amount.

Fall height removes the given amount of height from the fall distance and allows to fall higher before taking any damage at all.
Fall damage & height

Gun accuracy reduces the [spread](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@spread) of guns.

Extra Hearts increases the player's health points (hearts) by the given amount. Note: 1 Heart in the user interfaces represents 2 health points. 10 Hearts = 20 Health.
Accuracy & Hearts

Nightvision allows the player to activate nightvision with the **Toggle Night Vision**-key.

Step-Assist allows the player to toggle step-assist with the **Toggle Step Assist**-key. While step assist is active a full block height can be walked over without jumping.
Nightvision & Step-Assist
Gives the player a chance to avoid beeing knocked back by damage. If this chance exceeds 100%% a player can no longer be knocked back by damage.
Knockback Resistance
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.ban: The Bandit Armor is a Tier 1 armor and intended to be used for exploration in early game. It provides the best movement speed bonus out of all T1 armors.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.com: The Combat Armor is a Tier 2 armor and intended to be used for combat. It's stats are a direct upgrade of the [Soldier Armor](entry://armors/soldier_armor).
The Commando Armor is a Tier 2 armor intended for combat and under water activities.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.des: Techguns adds armor sets for different tech-tiers that are designed to be used from the beginning to the endgame. On the same tier there are usually different armors which have their own advantages and disadvantages.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.exo: The Exo Suit is a [powered](entry://armors/armor_mechanics@powered_armors) Tier 3 armor intended for combat with high movement bonuses and uses **Energy Cell**s for power. It's an upgrade of the [Advanced Combat Armor](entry://armors/advanced_combat_armor).
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.haz: The Hazmat Suit is a Tier 1 armor to provide protection against radiation.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.hev: The HEV or Hazardous Envirnonment Suit is a [powered](entry://armors/armor_mechanics@powered_armors) Tier 3 armor and requires **Energy Cell**s. It is designed for mining operations in dangerous environments.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.min: The Miner's Armor is a Tier 1 armor and intended to be used for mining in early game. It provides the best mining speed bonus out of all T1 armors.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.pow: The Power Armor is a [powered](entry://armors/armor_mechanics@powered_armors) Tier 3 armor intended for combat with strong defenses and uses **Energy Cell**s for power.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.ran: The Ranger Veteran Armor is an upgrade to the [Combat Armor](entry://armors/combat_armor). It also offers protection to radiation.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.sol: The Soldier's Armor is a Tier 1 armor and intended to be used for combat in early game. It provides the best defenses out of all T1 armors.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.armors.ste: The Steam Armor is the first [powered armor](entry://armors/armor_mechanics@powered_armors) and needs 'Compressed Air Tank's.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.descriptio: The Techguns manual: weapons, armor, machines and how to progress from the first gun to the endgame.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.doors.desc: Techguns adds special doors that can be configured for manual use, redstone signals or automatic player detection
book.techguns.techguns_manual.doors.door: To open the config gui of a Tech Door **\[Sneak + Right Click\]** it while holding a ['Wrench'](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@wrench). The doors have 3 modes: **'manual'**, **'redstone controlled'** or **'automatic'**. A manual door needs to be opened by **'right-clicking'** it, an automatic door reacts to players nearby. A redstone controlled door can be [configured like machines](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@redstone). The signal can come from all sides.

Doors can be configured to [security settings](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@security) like machines. Security settings are only relevant for 'Manual' and 'Automatic' mode, while redstone control is only needed in 'Redstone' mode. Auto-Close is only used in 'Manual' mode and closes the door 5 seconds after opening.

The two 'Hangar Doors' can be connected to a larger door. This means if you open a door, adjacent doors get opened as well. This overrides all security settings of neighbouring doors. If you want central control, neighbouring doors can be set to 'Redstone Mode' and 'Ignore Signal' to disable all other ways of opening.

book.techguns.techguns_manual.multiblock: The most complex machines in techguns are multiblocks and must be built together with multiple blocks. $(l:machine_mechanics)'Machine Mechanics'$(/l) are applicable to multiblock machines as well.

The fabricator is an advanced production machine that needs to be built as multiblock. To form the multiblock, the controller needs to be **right-clicked** while you look at the controller and it is the right of the two bottom blocks. This defines the front direction of the machine.

To build a fabricator you need:

- 3x Housing
- 4x Glass
- 1x Controller

Which means 8 housings need to be crafted in total.
A formed fabricator built in the world.

The fabricator has 4 input slots, 1 output slot and an [upgrade slot](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade).

- Input 1: the general input slot.
- Input 2: 'Wire' slot.
- Input 3: 'Powder' or 'Mechanical Parts' slot.
- Input 4: 'Plate' slot.

The machine knows what to put where with **'Shift+Click'** or through piping.

The reaction chamber is an advanced production machine that needs to be built as multiblock. To form the multiblock, the controller needs to be **right-clicked** while you look at the controller. This defines the front direction of the machine.

The input tank holds the liquid required for the reaction. The liquid level defines how much liquid should be pumped into the tank. The liquid level ranges from 0%% to 100%% where each 10%% step is equal to the amount of 1 bucket. Pipes can only pipe in liquid when the tank is below the target liquid level. Draining is only possible for the amount above the liquid level.

A good setup is to pump in and drain the liquid at the same time to a liquid tank from any mod placed near the chamber. The liquid level does not need to be adjusted during operation. To start a reaction the liquid level and amount in the tank must match to the recipe. After each operation some of the liquid may be consumed. This is defined by the recipe.

The reaction chamber has a minigame during a reaction. A recipe has **'Recipe Tick'** which happen every 3 seconds. During a such a tick the recipe gains **Completion** if intensity, liquidlevel and power requirement match. The two progress bars represent the reaction process. The green bar is the completion which needs to reach the end before the orange bar. The orange bar is the time restriction and always

progresses each recipe tick. How many completion is required depends on the recipe. The time limit can also be different. Each **'Recipe Tick'** power is consumed, this is another case for failure. If not enough power is stored no completion is gained. The power is consumed at once, that means there is a time frame of 3 seconds in which the machine must be filled with power again.

If a reaction fails there are some things that may happen depending on the recipe. The input item is always lost in case of failure. But some recipes may even cause an explosion of the reaction chamber.

- 'Break Item': input is lost
- 'Small Explosion': Chamber is damaged, room is safe.
- 'Medium Explosion': Chamber is destroyed, room is in danger, base is safe.

To build a reaction chamber you need:

- 17x Housing
- 18x Glass
- 1x Controller

Which means 36 housings need to be crafted in total.
A formed reaction chamber built in the world.

Power can be provided through the top middle block or directly to the controller. Items and Liquids can be piped in and out at the 3 housing blocks in the middle of each side of the bottom row. Piping is possible from the side or from the bottom.

- 1: Input slot
- 2: [Reaction Chamber Focus](entry://multiblock_machines/reaction_chamber@focus)
- 3: [Intensitiy Level](entry://multiblock_machines/reaction_chamber@intensity)
- 4: [Input Tank](entry://multiblock_machines/reaction_chamber@liquid)
- 5: [Liquid Level](entry://multiblock_machines/reaction_chamber@liquid)
- 6: Progress Bars
- 7: Output Slots
- 8: Power Bar

A reaction chamber focus is required to be placed in the focus slot.\
The heatray focus is the first focus that will be used in the chamber.\
A focus has no durability and is not consumed.

The intensity level has a range from 0 to 10 and must be set according to the recipe for starting the reaction.\
During a reaction tick which happens every 3 seconds the required intensity may change. If the intensity requires adjustment the bar turns orange.

book.techguns.techguns_manual.ore_drills: Ore Drills are a multiblock machine to drill resources from ore clusters which have an endless supply of ores.

Ore Cluster can be found in the world and need [Ore Drills](entry://ore_drills/ore_drills) to harvest resources. There are different ore cluster types and each holds different resources. Ore clusters are unbreakable and endless amount of ore can be harvested from them.

There are different cluster types and the output might vary depending on installed mods. For output details refer to JEI. Each type has a different mininglevel. Higher mininglevel need bigger drills or better drill item materials.

Calculating the required power per tick and amount of output is quite complicated. The following numbers are involved:

- **Clustersize**: amount of connected cluster blocks
- **Cluster Mining Level**: can be seen on the block tooltip
- **Drill Radius**: value from 0 to 4. 0 is a drill consisting of only [controller & rod](entry://ore_drills/ore_drills@tinydrill), for others it is radius including middle block.

- **Drill Rod Size**: amount of rod blocks in the drill
- **Engine Size**: the height of the engine block, which is the number of engine blocks between rod and controller.
- **Drill Item Mining level**: can be seen in the tooltip of the drill item.
- **Global Ore Multiplier**: read from config file
- **Global Power Multiplier**: read from config file

- **Cluster Ore Multiplier**: Cluster type individual multiplier, displayed in the block tooltip
- **Cluster Power Multiplier**: Cluster type individual multiplier to power, displayed in the block tooltip

- **Effective Mininglevel** = [Drill Item Mining Level](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas2) + [Drill Radius](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas) - [Cluster Mining Level](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas). The **Effective Mining Level** must be >= 0, otherwise the drill will only output cobblestone

- **Effective Cluster Size** = Minimum ( [Clustersize](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas), ( [Drill Rod Size](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas2) + [Engine Size](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas2) ))

**Ores per Hour** determines the ore output per time and is calculated the following way: ( ([Effective Cluster Size](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas4) \* 3 ) + ([Effective Cluster Size](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas4) \* [Effective Mining Level](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas4) \* 0.5 ) ) \* [Cluster Ore Multiplier](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas3) \* [Global Ore Multiplier](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas2)

The required power per tick is calculated the following: 8 \* [Ores Per Hour](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@ores_per_hour) \* ( 1 + Maximum ( [Drill Radius](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas) - 1, 0 ) \* 0.2 ) \* [Cluster Power Multiplier](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas3) \* [Global Power Multiplier](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas2)

The Power per Tick directly determines the RF requirement. Consuming Liquid or Solid Fuel has an own multiplier for fuel to RF.

Ore drills are multiblock machines and general [machine mechanics](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics) apply. Ore drills can be built in different sizes and rotations but must be adjacent to an ore cluster. There are 5 different block types involved in building an ore drill. The formulas for calculating output and power are explained [here](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@formulas).
The material of the drill defines the mining level of the drill. Iron has a mininglevel of 1, obsidian steel 2 and carbon 3.

The drill multiblock can be powered by cables or by inputting items that can be used as furnace fuel or liquid fuel. The power from items is calculated from the furnace burn time. Liquid fuel burn value is defined in the config file. Every fluid that is defined as 'fuel' in the config file is added with the same burn value. Formulas are explained [here](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters@power).
To start building an ore drill find an [ore cluster](entry://ore_drills/ore_clusters) and start with placing down the rod(s). To form the multiblock, **right+click** the controller.

The smallest possible drill is just 1 controller and 1 rod. All bigger sizes require a frame. The following constraints must hold:

- length of rods+engines \<= 16
- rod length >= drill diameter
- Engine block height >= radius
- rod length >= engine length

An ore drill item is required for the drill to work. Depending on the size of the multiblock a different drill size is required. In the gui when hovering the progress bar the radius of the drill is shown. A Radius of 0 (just controller and rod) needs a small drill, radius 1 and 2 require a medium drill, while 3 and 4 need a large drill.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.powered_ma: Ammo Press

The Ammo Press is an early game machine that is used for crafting the basic ammo types: 'Pistol Rounds', 'Shotgun shells', 'Rifle Rounds' and 'Sniper Rounds'. The machine has 3 input slots, 1 output slot and an [upgrade slot](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade).\
With the 2 buttons ( ' \< ' and ' > ' ) the type of ammo that is produced is changed, the resource costs are always the same, but the output amount differs per type.

- Input 1: Hard Metal / Core Metal, allowed: Steel Ingots and Lead Ingots, requires 1 Ingot per operation.
- Input 2: Soft Metal / Jacket Metal, allowed: Copper, Tin, Bronze, Iron, ... . Requires 2 Ingots per operation.
- Input 3: Gunpowder, 1 Item per operation.

Available Recipes may differ on mod setup and should be viewed with Just Enough Items (JEI).
Usage
Blast Furnace

The Blast Furnace is used for crafting 'Steel' and 'Obsidian Steel' and therefore required to advance to high tiers'. The machine has 2 input slots, 1 output slot and an [upgrade slot](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade).

The left input slot is for ingots, the right input slot for additional materials like coal. The amount of input items, the duration and required power may differ per recipe.\
Available Recipes may differ on mod setup and should be viewed with Just Enough Items (JEI).
Usage
Charging Station
The charging station is a mid-tier machine that is used for charging energy cells. The machine has 1 input slot, 1 output slot an [upgrade slot](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade).

Items that support Forge Energy (FE) API may also be charged in the charging station.\
Available Recipes may differ on mod setup and should be viewed with Just Enough Items (JEI).
Usage
Chemical Laboratory

The Chemical Laboratory is an early game machine that is used for some utility crafting recipes and for filling tanks and compressed air cells. The machine has 1 input tank, 2 item input slots, 1 output slot, 1 output tank and an [upgrade slot](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade).

The third input slot is currently not used. Recipes may need different combinations on input liquid and items. Not all slots need to be used in each recipe. The 'toggle drain' button can be used to change which tank should be drained with pipes. This also applies to 'Right-clicking' with an empty bucket (or other fluid container). Filling is possible with both tanks and pipes.
Usage

Both tanks have a 'dump' button that deletes the content of the tank.\
Available Recipes may differ on mod setup and should be viewed with Just Enough Items (JEI).
Usage
Techguns machines that require to be powered.
Grinder
The Grinder is used to recycle guns, armors and some other items. It has an input slot, 9 output slots and an [upgrade slot](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade).

The left input slot is for input, the right slots are for output.\
Available Recipes may differ on mod setup and should be viewed with Just Enough Items (JEI).
Usage
* Machine Mechanics *

Techguns machines share a few mechanics. This includes: [Power](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@power), [Security Settings](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@security) and [Redstone Control](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@redstone). Power and Redstone Control is only relevant to powered machines, while Security Settings are also applicable to simple machines. The ['Upgrade Slot'](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade) is also a shared mechanic between multiple machines.

Techguns machines share the concept to not need side configuration. This means input and extraction from pipes can come from any side. Recipes are designed in a way that for each item it must be deterministic in which slot it belongs. Extraction from machines require pipes with 'extract' mode as the machines do not output to inventories themselves.
Side Configuration

Security Settings allow to restrict access to a machine. Machines have a lock-button that has 4 states.

- public
- allies
- team
- owner

No matter what setting, only the owner (=the player who placed the machine) can change the security setting.
Security Settings
To make use of the 'allies' and 'team' settings you need FTBUtilies installed. Without FTBU 'allies' and 'team' is equal to 'public'.
Security Settings

Machines that have a power bar on the left side of the gui require power to operate. The power system used by techguns is **'FE'** or **'Forge Energy'** which is also compatible with most RF (Redstone Flux) based cables. Techguns has no options to generate power itself, you need another mod to produce it. Alternatively you can disable power requirement in the techguns.cfg config file.
Power

With redstone control a machine can be configured to react to redstone signals. The indicator in the top left with a red and green light indicate the current state. This allows to turn off machines by redstone signals. By default a machine ignores signals.
Redstone Control

Some machines have an upgrade slot in the bottom right of their gui. In this slot 'Machine Upgrades' can be placed. The 'Stack Operation' upgrade allows the machine to process the same recipe multiple times at once. The stack upgrade can be applied up to 7 times allowing to process a recipe up to 8x simultaneously.
Upgrade Slot

As many other tech mods, Techguns also has a 'wrench' item. The crowbar is Techguns version of a wrench, but can also be used as pickaxe and for hitting enemies. The crowbar allows to rotate techguns machines or can dismantle them ( **'Sneak + Right Click'**). Technically everything that has the tool class 'wrench' is considered as wrench.
'Wrench'
Metal Press

The Metal Press is an early game machine that is used for crafting plates and a few other items required by techguns. The machine has 2 input slots, 1 output slot and an [upgrade slot](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@upgrade).

All recipes require two input items and have one output. The 'stack split' button is to allow automation for recipes which require the same item twice. If one slot is empty and the item in the other slot has a recipe where it is needed twice the stack will be split.\
Available Recipes may differ on mod setup and should be viewed with Just Enough Items (JEI).
Usage
Machines
Turret

The turret can be built quite early in the game but requires a power supply to function.

Any Techgun can be mounted on the turret, even melee weapons like the chainsaw.

The turret base spawns a turret NPC that can be equipped with a techguns weapon. Power is constantly needed for operation and additional power is consumed for repairing the turret npc. Turrets can also be placed upside down by facing the bottom of a block while placing the turret or by using a ['Wrench'](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@wrench) on the bottom face.

The turret gui has multiple slots, the left 3x3 slots are for ammo, the right 3x3 slots store empty magazines. The two slots in the middle are for equipping a gun and a turret armor which increases the armor rating of the turret npc. When the turret NPC dies the base will spawn a new one after a repair delay but needs additional power during that process.
Usage

How far the turret detects enemies and attacks them depends on the type of weapon that is equipped. There are buttons on the left side of the gui to change the attacking behaviour of the turret. This allows to specify if other players should be attacked. This is similar to [Security Settings](entry://powered_machines/machine_mechanics@security). There is also a button to toggle if neutral animals should get killed.
Turret AI
book.techguns.techguns_manual.simple_mac:
The camo bench allows to change the texture of techguns items but also can recolor vanilla blocks like wool.\
Put an item the top left slot and press the buttons to change the color. The camo of currently equipped armor parts can also be changed directly.
Techguns adds a few 'simple' machines that do not require power. $(l:machine_mechanics#security)Security Settings$(/l) may still be applicable.

The Repair Bench is used to repair techguns armors. It does not need power. The cost for repairing is shown as tooltip when hovering the repair button. Repairing should always be cheaper than crafting a new armor.
The upgrade bench is used to add upgrades to Techguns armors. Technically upgrades are equal to vanilla enchants.

Add the Techguns armor in the left slot and the armor upgrade in the middle slot. If the input is valid the right slot shows the output. The upgrade is applied when the output item is taken. Upgrading also costs XP. The needed amount and the player's current XP is shown in the gui. Upgrading to a high level of the same type costs less xp.
Each armor upgrade shows which enchantment and level it holds. The xp cost is cheaper when the same upgrade with a lower level is already present.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.survival_g: Tutorial on how to start out and progress to the endgame.
0. Starting Out

Techguns can be used very early in a new world. The 'Hand Cannon' only needs a few logs and stones and 1 flint and iron ingot plus some gunpowder. Mobs using Techguns weapons may also be encountered early. Be careful when not geared yet.

The first step is to collect some resources like iron, coal and maybe redstone and built a basic power generation setup (depends on what mods are installed). After power is available the first machines of techguns can be built, the [Metal Press](entry://powered_machines/metal_press), the [Ammo Press](entry://powered_machines/ammo_press), [Chemical Laboratory](entry://powered_machines/chemical_laboratory) and the [Blast Furnace](entry://powered_machines/blast_furnace). The [Camo Bench](entry://simple_machines/camo_bench), the [Repair Bench](entry://simple_machines/repair_bench) can also be used from the beginning but are not required to progress.
Starting out

Since techguns mobs are dangerous you should get a full suit of one of the first three armor sets. This includes the 'Bandit Armor' which gives the best speed bonus and is good for scouting, the 'Miner Armor' which is best for mining or the 'Soldier Armor' which offers the best protection in gunfights.
Get Armor

To better fight of mobs you should get a better weapon than a handgun. At this point all weapon requiring an 'Iron Receiver' can be built. The 'Power Hammer' is good mining tool and should also be built early to improve your mining speed. It can later be upgraded to higher mining levels.
Get Weapons
1. Preparing for Nether
To progress further into Techguns you need to get to the nether, but the nether is a very dangerous place so you need to get the best weapons and armor available at the current tech level.

Before you got to the nether you should have established a base and setup ore processing systems and power generation from other mods. You need to mine obsidian to build a nether portal but obsidian is also need for the best pre-nether equipment.
Establish Base

The recommended armor setup is a full 'Steam' or 'Ranger Veteran' armor set. A combat armor might be enough too, but don't fight in the nether with tier 1 armors. For weapons you want to craft an 'AKM' or 'Bolt Action Rifle'.
Armor and Weapons
2. Nether Expedition

The first nether expedition should involve collecting some 'Nether Quartz' which opens up new crafting options. It is recommended to not stay in the nether too long and use the mined quartz to further gear up.
Building a Jetpack allows to easier navigate in the nether. After that collecting some blaze rods and 'Cybernetic Parts' that drop from Cyber Demons should be the next objective.
Progressing

After enough cybernetic parts are collected to build a [Fabricator](entry://multiblock_machines/fabricator) and a [Reaction Chamber](entry://multiblock_machines/reaction_chamber) it is possible to advance to the next tech-tier. The Fabricator can produce cybernetic parts so it is recommended to build that one first.
Advanced Machines
3. High-Tech Weaponry
With a [Fabricator](entry://multiblock_machines/fabricator) and a [Reaction Chamber](entry://multiblock_machines/reaction_chamber) you have access to new high-tech weapons and armors.
The reaction chamber can process titanium ore needed for tier 3 armors. Also it is possible to enrich uranium for nuclear weapons. The fabricator produces energy cells and other items needed.
Advanced Processing
If you acquire a nether star you can craft the 'anti-gravity device' allowing you to use creative flight when worn.

book.techguns.techguns_manual.tg_invento: Information about Techguns Inventory tab and additional slots slots.
There are a few indicator symbols in the HUD that show the status of Techguns effects. Some can be toggled by [button](entry://tg_inventory/tg_inventory_tab@buttons) or keybind.
The symbols used in the Techguns HUD and for [buttons](entry://tg_inventory/tg_inventory_tab@buttons) in the [Techguns Inventory Tab](entry://tg_inventory/tg_inventory_tab).
From the survival inventory the player can switch to the techguns inventory tab by clicking the buttons at the top.
Techguns adds 3 additional armor slots where special items can be worn. The slots are **'Face'**, **'Back'** and **'Hands'**. Items in this slots give different abilities or bonus stats.

There are also additional inventory slots for ammo to not clutter the inventory. Currently 8 slots are available for ammo. Every item that is used as ammo or battery can be put there. Reloading checks for ammo in the ammo inventory first, empty magazines and batteries also get put there first.

The 3 food slots allow to store food items that automatically get eaten when needed. Automatic feeding can be disabled in the config file.

There also is a healing item slot indicated with a + which is NOT USED as of version 2.0.1.2.

On the left side of the Techguns Inventory there are small buttons to toggle bonus effects like 'Nightvision' or 'Jetpacks'. This buttons also have keybinds which can be viewed in the keybind options.\
The first button toggles the visibility of all [Techguns HUD elements](entry://tg_inventory/tg_hud@images).
book.techguns.techguns_manual.weapons.de: Techguns weapons exist for different tech-tiers and are designed to be used from the beginning to the endgame. Some weapons are also tools like the powerhammer or the chainsaw.
book.techguns.techguns_manual.weapons.we: * Weapon Mechanics *

Weapons have a left click action and optionally a **right click action**. The **left click action** is either primary fire or melee when the weapon is a tool or a melee weapon. The **right-click action** differs between weapon. Some weapons do not have a **right-click action**, others have zooming, secondary fire mode or a charging attack.

There are three different hand types for weapons: **'One-Handed'**, **'Two-Handed'** and **'Dual Wield Penalty'**. 'Dual Wield Penalty' is like 'One-Handed' but gets an accuracy penalty when used with dual wielding. 'Two-Handed' weapons always block the second hand. The off-hand item is not rendered and cannot be used. Only 'Two-Handed' weapons can have a right click action but don't always have to.
Hand Types

A gun that has no more ammo left will be reloaded when you try to shoot it, provided that there is enough ammo left in your inventory. There is also a keybind ( **Force Reload**) to force-reload a weapon. This allows to reload partially emptied guns but can cause loss of ammunition. If for example a magazine needs 3 bullet items to craft and the gun is reloaded with 25/30 shots, you only get 2 bullet items back.
Reloading

Guns do NOT have durability. The durability bar on the item shows how much percent ammo is left. Ammunition is the only operation cost. The ammo count is also shown in left bottom corner of the screen in the following format: \<ammo in magazine>/\<magazine capacity> x \<how often you can reload from your inventory>.
Ammo and Durability

Guns have a safe mode that avoids all block damage. The safe mode can be toggle with the **Toggle Safe Mode**-key. With safe mode enabled weapons like a rocket launcher can be used near your base without blowing everything up. Server administrators can force players to use the safe mode.
Safe mode
The icon showing the current state of safe-mode while holding a gun.
Safe mode Indicator
* Weapon Stats *

When holding \[shift\] a detailed tooltip shows all stats of a weapon.

- [Hand-Type](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@handtype_ammo)
- [Ammo](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@handtype_ammo)
-
- [Damage](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@damage_type)
- [Range](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@range)
- [Velocity](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@velocity)
- [Spread](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@spread)
- [Clipsize](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@clipsize_reload)
- [Reload time](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@clipsize_reload)
- [Armor Pen](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@armorpen)
- [Zoom](entry://weapons/weapon_stats@zoom)

[Hand-Type](entry://weapons/weapon_mechanics@hand_types) determines if a weapon can be dual wielded and if it has an accuracy penalty when doing so.

'Ammo' indicates the items needed to reload the gun. This is usually 1 magazine but can also be an amount higher than 1 (eg. shotgun) or 2 different item types (eg. gauss rifle)
Hand-Type & Ammo

Damage Type defines the type of damage a weapon deals (Who would have thought?) and damage defines the amount. There are two different damage values (e.g 10-6). The first value is the damage dealt at close range the second value is the minimum damage dealt at far ranges. At which ranges the damage drop occurs is defined by the weapon range.
Damage Type & Damage

Weapon range defines at what distance the damage drops occur. Range has 3 different values, e.g. 10,20,30. This means the weapon will deal maximum damage up to a distance of 10 blocks. Between 10 and 20 the damage is linearly interpolated between maximum and minimum damage. Between 20 and 30 distance minimum damage is dealt. At distance 30 the projectile disappears.
Range

Velocity defines how fast the projectile of the weapon flies. The unit for this is blocks per tick. A tick happens 20 times per second in minecraft. So a velocity of 2.0 means the projectile flies a distance of 40 blocks per second. This might not be applicable for some weapons like lasers where there is no travel time.
Velocity

Spread defines how accurate a weapon is. The spread value is the angular offset that gets randomly added when shooting. A spread of 0 means a perfectly straight shot. A low value is more accurate. Most weapons that can zoom in have reduced spread when zoomed in. A second spread value prefixed with 'Z:' shows the spread the weapon has while zoomed in.
Spread

The clipsize defines how much ammo is in a clip or magazine.

The reloadtime defines how long it takes to reload the gun in seconds.
Clipsize & Reloadtime
Armor Pen stands for 'Armor Penetration'. WIP damage formulas are not final.
Armor Pen

This defines the kind of zooming behaviour for this weapon. Not every weapon has a zoom. Zoom:(toogle) means the zoom is toggled when right-clicking. 'Mult:' which stands for multiplier defines how strong the zoom is. Mult:0.35 means the Field of View is multiplied by 0.35 while zooming.
Zoom
